subject: Increased latency & errors after model upgrade
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <priya@stellarbank.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@stellarbank.com
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Increased latency & errors after model upgrade

Hi Evelyn,

We rolled the v3.1 model and the new quant profile (q5) into our dedicated pool last night around 02:00 UTC. Since then we've seen a sharp jump in p95 latency (from ~220ms to ~780ms) and a spike in 500 errors for our high-throughput endpoints. This started immediately after the deployment window.

I've attached a small bundle of perf logs and trace snippets (perf_logs_0913.zip). Can you confirm whether Redwood pushed any other infra-side changes or if this is expected with q5? We're seeing customer-facing impact and need an ETA for mitigation.

- Priya
Director of Platform Ops
StellarBank

Attachments: perf_logs_0913.zip

Subject: Re: Increased latency & errors after model upgrade

Thanks Priya — I see the spikes in the logs you attached. Really sorry for the impact. I'm escalating to our infra + model team right now (cc'd).

Immediate asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm whether q5 has any known kernel/runtime incompatibilities on the Dedicated pool hardware we run for StellarBank?
- Priya: if you can paste a short call sample (payload + response id) from the 500s that would help triage.

I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth and DM with updates. Planning to request a rollback option while we diagnose.

Evelyn
Senior AM, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya@stellarbank.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Sep 2026 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Increased latency & errors after model upgrade

Evelyn / team — initial read: q5 introduces an aggressive quant codepath (collapsed attention kernels) that performs well for longer sequences but regresses for short, high-concurrency hot-paths we see in StellarBank. The runtime picks a different kernel selector at token-length distribution extremes; we've seen that cause context switch thrash and lock contention on the custom mempool when concurrency spikes.

What I recommend now (short window mitigation):
1) Roll back to q4 profile for the StellarBank dedicated pool (q4 is the previous profile configured per-deployment).
2) Pin model binary to v3.0-compat for the next 8 hours while we run a targeted repro with the sample calls.
3) Collect perf counters (I've attached qprofile_diff_q5-vs-q4.json with the kernel selector diffs).

Estimated time to rollback (if we have approval): 30–45 minutes to schedule, ~10–15 minutes to propagate and validate. Post-rollback, I'll run a controlled canary to ensure error rate and p95 return to baseline before fully clearing.

I'll open a Jira ticket and push additional telemetry to the Datadog dashboard.

Karthik
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: qprofile_diff_q5-vs-q4.json
